title: Comparison of Piezoelectric and Conventional Surgery for Germectomy of the Lower Third Molar
official: Comparison of Piezoelectric and Conventional Surgery for Germectomy of the Lower Third Molar: Assessment of Post-operative Sequelae
summary: The main objective of the study is to compare the effects of the piezoelectric surgery and the traditional technique on soft tissue edema in patients undergoing bilateral germectomy of mandibular third molars

interventions.name: Piezoelectric technique in third molar germectomy
Traditional technique in third molar germectomy

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients aged between 14 and 24 years, with both lower third molars in the developmental stage (with incompletely formed roots) and requiring extraction of both for prophylactic, therapeutic or strategic reasons
* Good quality of radiographic investigations (CBCT)
* Good health status
